title: Bormann alive in Argentina, cashing checks via Chase

tellings.quote: And as late as the 1960s Martin Borman is cashing checks written in his own name through Chase JP Morgan Chase in >> Buenos Iris.

plain: A researcher and writer named Jason Jorjani says that Martin Bormann, a top Nazi official and Hitler's close aide, did not die at the end of World War Two in 1945 but escaped to Buenos Aires, Argentina, in the time of the Argentine leader Juan Perón. Jorjani says that as late as the 1960s Bormann was cashing checks written in his own name through the big American bank Chase, now JP Morgan Chase. If true, it would mean a leading Nazi lived openly abroad for decades with help from the banking world.
